title: Find Repeated Elements in Sorted Array

content.problemStatement: Complete the code snippet below to print all the repeated elements in a sorted array.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find and print all repeated elements in a sorted array in ascending order.

code.Python3:
import sys
from collections import Counter
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    c = Counter(arr)
    rep = [str(x) for x in sorted(c.keys()) if c[x] > 1]
    print(" ".join(rep))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()
